variantId.description: Prices a specific variant instead of the base product — e.g. different sizes/colors with different prices. Never a serial/batch: pricing is always at product/variant (SKU) level, never per physical unit.

minimumQuantity.description: Decimal, not just whole units (Deel 17 §29) — e.g. 4.5 kg.

locationId.description: Must be one of your own organization's Locations.

whereToFindVisible.description: Deel 16 §46 product-level opt-out — set false to exclude this specific offer from Where to Find even if your org is enabled.
